title: What's on Your Phone? Girls Night Party Game: 30 Prompts, 3 Colors & Ink Saver, A4 and Letter PDF
description:
A little friendly competition for your girls' night, bridal shower or bachelorette gathering. Find the everyday essentials and unexpected things already on your phone, tick the boxes and see whose score comes out on top.

I designed this print-and-play game with clear scoring, room for notes and a choice of colors to suit your table.

WHAT IS INCLUDED
One original 30-prompt game with 10 prompts worth 1 point, 10 worth 5 points and 10 worth 10 points. Maximum score: 160.
Three color versions: Cherry, Sage and Cobalt, plus a dedicated black-and-white Ink Saver game sheet.
Host rules and a scoreboard for 12 guests; print an extra scoreboard for larger groups.

FILES & SIZES
One ZIP with two six-page PDFs and a quick-start/license TXT file.
A4: 210 x 297 mm. US Letter: 8.5 x 11 inches.
Each PDF contains the same six pages: Cherry game, Sage game, Cobalt game, Ink Saver game, host rules and scoreboard. These are color and paper-size versions of ONE game, not multiple different games.
English wording. Static printable PDFs for handwriting, not editable templates or fillable forms. Text and linework are vector-based. The small ribbon illustration is embedded at over 1000 effective PPI at print size.

HOW TO PLAY
Download the ZIP directly from your Etsy purchases and unzip. Print one chosen game page per guest, plus the host rules and scoreboard as needed. Add pens and the guests' own phones. Use the matching paper-size PDF and print at Actual size / 100%; no cutting or borderless printer is needed.
Count only items that existed before the host says GO. Use a different photo, file or entry for each checked box. Multiply checks by the column value, add the totals, and share the win in a tie. The host chooses the stop time; no fixed playtime is promised.

KEEP IT COMFORTABLE
No one needs to hand over their phone, show a screen, reveal private messages or play recordings. Self-reporting is enough and any prompt can be skipped. No alcohol, dares or social posting is required. No game app, special account or paid download is needed; a guest may skip features their phone does not have.

BEFORE BUYING
This is a digital product. No printed game, phone, pens, drinks, props, app, Canva template link or seller customization is included. Scores are added by hand. The Ink Saver option applies to the game page; the host rules and scoreboard have light cherry accents. Print a test page; colors vary by printer and paper.

PERSONAL USE
Use for one private celebration and print copies for its guests. No commercial event-planner/client license, resale, redistribution, public upload or artwork resale is included. Buyer PDFs have no promotional watermarks.

The small watercolor ribbon illustration was created with AI assistance and incorporated into my page designs. Promotional table photos are illustrative; the full-contents image shows the actual PDF pages.

Need help accessing the files? Please message Pinogri through Etsy.
